minor.issue: Silently drops unknown game slugs (filters via 'if s in GAME_SLUGS') instead of returning 400. A typo client-side returns 200 with a quietly-truncated list — masks bugs. Recommend explicit 400 when any submitted slug is not in GAME_SLUGS.
Daily-cap enforcement is read-then-insert (no atomic compare-and-set). Under burst-concurrent requests the cap could be exceeded by 1-2. Low-risk at current scale; flag for prod hardening.

Reuses _validate_and_store_files which enforces a 100-byte minimum image size. Very small valid PNGs (e.g., 1x1) are rejected as 'empty or corrupted'. Acceptable but worth documenting in API docs; tests now use a 50x50 PNG (~137 bytes).
(Carry-over from iter6) Spec'd path returns 405 — actual handler is at /api/deep-dive/guided/{sid}. Frontend does not exercise yet.

POST /api/billing/pro-games silently filters invalid slugs (line 2207). Recommend explicit 400 — the current behavior returned 200 to my first 3-slug exceed test because one of the slugs ('kingshot') wasn't a valid GAME_SLUG, masking the over-slot path.

scouts_earn handler mixes multipart (file), form (video_id, game_tried), and path (kind) inputs in one route. Works but harder to validate. Consider splitting into 4 dedicated routes or using a discriminated Pydantic model.

scouts_earn emits milestones with game_slug=None — /api/milestones?game_slug=... will not surface scout activity for any per-game timeline view. Either pass the provoking game_slug (when available, e.g., game_tried) or document this as intentional.

rca of the issue: No bugs found. Two initial test failures were test-data issues (not code bugs): (a) the over-slot test used 'kingshot' which isn't in GAME_SLUGS so the silent-filter dropped it to 2 valid → 200; fixed by switching to 'wartune'. (b) the 1x1 PNG fixture was 67 bytes, below the 100-byte minimum in _validate_and_store_files; fixed by using a 50x50 PNG (~137 bytes). One real code-smell surfaced from issue (a): POST /api/billing/pro-games silently drops invalid slugs — recommend explicit 400 (documented in minor backend_issues).
